method: Each saved problem is restored from its generator-version, seed, generationAttempt and conditions; analyzeWaterSortNaturalPlay is invoked with trialCount 60 and createProblemSeededRandom(`natural-play:${seed}`), matching frontend/scripts/generate-water-sort-problem-pool.ts.
reliability: This is exact self-reproducibility of the shipped classifier and seeded random simulation, not validation of whether the random strategy reflects a human player.
correction: The stored rate in this snapshot was estimated with 60 trials, not 30. The three additional policies (12 runs each) are a separate sensitivity experiment; previous comparison incorrectly claimed the stored rate used 30 runs.
evidence: One-off runnable test frontend/scripts/tmp-issue660-water-natural-recheck.test.ts and per-chunk JSON results are in conversation evidence ZIP.
